camel_example: aliyun winnexo POST /openapi/listTodos --region cn-hangzhou --opsUserCode alice --opsUserId 10001 --appToken wn_app_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx --tenantId 10000 --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'readStatus=[UNREAD, READ]&collaborationGroupId=cg_123&priorities=[HIGH, MEDIUM]&sourceTypes=[WORKFLOW, OPEN_API]&maxResults=20&nextToken=example&pageSize=20&statuses=[PENDING, COMPLETED]&sortBy=DEFAULT&page=1&keyword=审批' --version 2026-05-12 --force
description_en: Performs a paging query for the to-do list
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo list-todos --app-token wn_app_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx --ops-user-id 10001 --ops-user-code alice --tenant-id 10000 --read-status UNREAD READ --statuses PENDING COMPLETED --priorities HIGH MEDIUM --source-types WORKFLOW OPEN_API --collaboration-group-id cg_123 --keyword '审批' --sort-by DEFAULT --page 1 --page-size 20 --max-results 20 --next-token example --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTodos

parameters.help_en: The platform application token issued by the console. If specified, the operation is performed as the user identified by opsUserId or opsUserCode
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用 Token（控制台签发）。传入后将以 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定的用户身份执行
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The proxy user ID, which is the WINNEXO platform user ID. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as winnexo_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID），仅当应用凭证配置为 winnexo_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The proxy user code, which is unique within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as source_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户编码（租户内唯一），仅当应用凭证配置为 source_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The read status filter. Valid values: UNREAD, READ. The status is determined by the readAt time of the assignee
parameters.help_zh: 读取状态筛选（UNREAD/READ，按处理人 readAt 判定）
parameters.name: read_status

parameters.help_en: The to-do status filter. Valid values: PENDING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.help_en: The priority filter. Valid values: HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
parameters.name: priorities

parameters.help_en: The to-do type filter. Valid values: WORKFLOW, OPEN_API
parameters.name: source_types

parameters.help_en: The collaboration workspace ID. This is an optional filter. If not specified, all workspaces are included
parameters.help_zh: 协作空间 ID（可选过滤；不传 = 全部空间）
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword for fuzzy search in the title or summary
parameters.help_zh: 标题/摘要模糊搜索关键词
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The page number. This parameter is ignored if nextToken is specified
parameters.help_zh: 页码；传入 nextToken 时忽略
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter takes precedence over pageSize if both are specified
parameters.help_zh: 单页最大返回数量（1~100）；传入时优先于 pageSize
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Use the nextToken value returned in the previous response. This parameter takes precedence over page if both are specified
parameters.help_zh: 翻页令牌，取上次响应返回的 nextToken；传入时优先于 page
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

hasMore.description_en: Specifies whether more data is available

items.description_en: The list of to-do items on the current page
The list of to-do items on the current page
items.example: {"todoId":"todo_abc123","title":"治理审批","priority":"HIGH","status":"COMPLETED","myAssigneeStatus":"COMPLETED","myDisplayState":"DONE","completedByUserId":"42","completedByUserName":"张三","completedAt":"2026-10-12 10:00:00","isRead":"false","sourceType":"WORKFLOW","assigneeCount":"2","sourceContext":{"source":"openapi"},"messageId":"msg-1","gmtCreate":"2026-10-12 10:00:00","gmtModified":"2026-10-12 10:00:00","questionCount":"1","questionSummaries":["是否同意该方案"]}

completedAt.description_en: The completion time in UTC+8. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
completedAt.description_zh: 完成时间（北京时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss）

completedByUserId.description_en: The user ID of the user who completed the item. This field is empty if the item is not completed
completedByUserId.description_zh: 完成人用户ID；未完成为空

completedByUserName.description_en: The name of the user who completed the item. This field is empty if the item is not completed
completedByUserName.description_zh: 完成人姓名；未完成为空

gmtCreate.description_en: The creation time in UTC+8. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
gmtCreate.description_zh: 创建时间（北京时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss）

gmtModified.description_en: The last modification time in UTC+8. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
gmtModified.description_zh: 最后修改时间（北京时间 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss）

isRead.description_en: Specifies whether the caller has read the item

messageId.description_en: The ID of the assistant message that generated the to-do item. This field is empty if there is no conversation source
messageId.description_zh: 发出该待办的 assistant 消息ID；无会话来源为空

myAssigneeStatus.description_en: The action status of the caller as an assignee
myAssigneeStatus.description_zh: 调用者的处理人行状态

myDisplayState.description_en: The list display status for the caller
myDisplayState.description_zh: 调用者的列表展示状态

sourceContext.description_en: The source context. This is passed through as-is during creation
sourceContext.description_zh: 来源上下文（创建时原样透传）

sourceType.description_en: The source type of the to-do item

status.description_en: The primary status of the to-do item

maxResults.description_en: The effective maximum number of entries returned per page for this request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次生效的单页最大返回数量

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. This is an empty string if no more data is available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页翻页令牌；无更多数据时为空字符串

pageSize.description_en: The effective number of entries per page

total.description_en: The total number of visible items under the filter conditions
